subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next Friday afternoon at the city park. This event is a great opportunity for us to bond and unwind together outside of the office environment. There will be fun team-building activities, snacks, and drinks provided. Please RSVP by the end of this week so we can finalize the arrangements. We can't wait to see you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
